verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer connects to 400+ services through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth. They name integrations such as Gmail, Outlook, GitHub, Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Snowflake and Salesforce, and describe an in-task auth_required flow for connecting a service. Nothing in the evidence describes a browsable directory or marketplace where a user discovers and adds connectors, and the connector claims come from a single docs page. missing for 10: a documented browsable connector/app directory UI, a user-facing flow for adding and managing connectors, third-party app submissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
